messages.content: The Cedar meeting is in Room 4 at 2:00. Summarize that.
Cedar meeting: Room 4 at 2:00.
Update: it moved to Room 7, but the time is unchanged.
Cedar meeting: Room 7 at 2:00.
Help me choose a notebook. I prefer lined pages and a blue cover.
Look for a blue, lined notebook.
I changed my mind about the cover. Make it green.
Look for a green notebook with lined pages.
Add the delivery to my afternoon plan.
What time is the delivery?
It arrives at 3:30.
Afternoon plan: receive the delivery at 3:30.
I need to pack three shirts, one jacket, and toiletries tonight. Make a short checklist.
Checklist: three shirts, one jacket, toiletries.
Put toiletries first because I may forget them.
Checklist: toiletries, three shirts, one jacket.
Reply with exactly: Maple order confirmed
Maple order confirmed
Now reply with exactly: Maple order paused
Maple order paused
Use only this note: “The workshop begins Monday and ends Wednesday.” When does it end?
It ends Wednesday.
Does the note say what time it ends?
No. The note does not provide an ending time.
The supply list has four folders and six pens. Restate it.
Supply list: four folders and six pens.
Correction: we need eight pens, not six.
Supply list: four folders and eight pens.
Draft a reminder saying the rehearsal starts at the scheduled time.
What is the scheduled start time?
It starts at 5:15.
Reminder: The rehearsal starts at 5:15.
Plan these chores in order: wash the cups, dry them, then store them.
1. Wash the cups. 2. Dry them. 3. Store them.
Add “clear the shelf” immediately before storing them.
1. Wash the cups. 2. Dry them. 3. Clear the shelf. 4. Store the cups.
List the guests as a sentence: Lumen, Birch, and Cove.
The guests are Lumen, Birch, and Cove.
Instead, put each name on its own line.

Lumen
Birch
Cove
Given only this text—“Tray A holds five cups; Tray B holds three”—which tray holds more?
Tray A holds more cups.
How many more, based on the text?
Tray A holds two more cups than Tray B.
Suggest a break activity from this list: stretching, reading, or walking. I want something indoors and active.
Stretching fits: it is active and can be done indoors.
Actually, I want a quiet activity instead.
Reading fits the updated preference for a quiet activity.
Make a plan: review notes at 9:00, then call the supplier at 10:00.

9:00 — Review notes
10:00 — Call the supplier
Move the review to 8:30. Keep the call unchanged.

8:30 — Review notes
10:00 — Call the supplier
Mira gave Sol a folder. Put it on the desk.
Should I interpret “it” as the folder?
Yes, the folder.
Place the folder on the desk.
From this sentence, return only the item name: “The crate contains a silver lantern.”
silver lantern
Now return only its color.
silver
Create a two-item snack list using only pears, crackers, and cheese. Include pears.
Pears and crackers.
New constraint: exclude crackers.
Pears and cheese.
